scope: Diagnostic profrun-wrapped original workload arguments; exact qualified outputs and guest validators. Counters cover child fork/exec through exit, excluding boot and validators. No timings used.

gcc_purpose_check.shadow_cache_selftests: PASS actual C cache routines: hit, capacity eviction, root/value key separation and generation-flush reset

inputs.original_inputs: All original input/binary hashes match spec-rebase-qualification.json; only profrun observer added
inputs.build: Clang O2, non-LTO diagnostic export; never used for performance timing

definitions.live_arrays: Rows data/PCC; columns calls, watched-cache hit, direct-record-cache access, slow lookup
definitions.walks: Calls to paged cap_rev_table_record_pa after table/ID validity checks; includes lifetime operations outside capstone_id_live
definitions.levels: 0 root directory pointer, 1 middle directory pointer, 2 record-page pointer; each successful walk reads all three
definitions.cache_models: Fully associative LRU with 1/4/16 entries separately per level, cold at start; key=(root, entry physical address, observed pointer value). Model 0 measures raw observed-value locality. Model 1 additionally clears all entries on observed table-generation or global watched-write-generation changes before a walk.
definitions.reuse: Shadow hits divided by observed directory-pointer reads. Both models still execute every real read and check; no cached value influences architectural state.

findings: Every workload uses only one root-directory entry and one middle-directory entry; record-page working sets range from 1 to 28 pages.
Each slow liveness lookup produces four directory walks in these runs. Extra purpose counters on GCC attribute two to table-open allocation preflight, one to liveness, and one to cache fill.
Directory locality supports testing a small cache and eliminating redundant walks before changing leaf size; the current software walk count is not a mandatory RTL access count.
limitations: These are logical QEMU table operations, not CPU data-cache misses or DRAM transactions.
The slow fraction is conditional on calls reaching capstone_id_live. Successful inline register/PCC proofs bypass that helper and are not in its denominator.

Generation-flush shadow results are opportunity estimates, not a coherence/security proof: mapping lifetime, root reuse, concurrent writers and all invalidation paths need validation before implementing a cache. The observed-pointer value in the key is an oracle unavailable without the real read.
Single-hart short workloads, largely one protected process. Results do not establish multiprocess working sets, longer-run locality, or speedup.
Directory-read reuse does not eliminate record/header reads, validation, or other work.
Training/diagnostic host timings are excluded. No default binary, guest ISA or table format changed.

First preparation attempt referenced a missing observer path and stopped before execution. First negative-control preparation found two compiler-emitted stop sites; both verified HINT sites were suppressed for the successful negative run.
